notes.title: Cross-art Contest
notes.content:
Do you want to win a copy of the games Be Hero, Dininho Adventures Definitive or Raccoo Venture? What about winning all of them at the same time?

Send your fanart with the theme 'cross-over' between the 3 games until April 12th, 2021 at 21:00 (UTC) through the form below and participate in the livestream to choose the best fanart on April 12th, 2021 at 23:00 (UTC) on twitch.tv/mirabolis. The author of the chosen fanart will receive the keys for the three games (Steam).

ENTRY FORM

And don't forget to participate in the chat of the contest livestream with the developers of the games. It will be really fun!

We are waiting for you!

CONTEST RULES:

- Theme: Cross-over between Be Hero, Dininho Adventures Definitive and Raccoo Venture
- Deadline for art submission: April 12th, 2021 at 21:00 (UTC)
- Date and place of contest livestream: April 12th, 2021at 23:00 (UTC) on twitch.tv/mirabolis
- You can submit as many arts as you wish.
- Adult-themed, offensive or violent arts are not allowed.
